beats.text: India: 27.4% of babies are born underweight. In Iceland, it is 4%.
India has the world's highest rate. A difficult start for newborns weighing less than 2,500 grams.
This counts weight within the 1st hour of life, before significant postnatal weight loss has occurred.
India has 3.3 times the underweight newborns the USA has, where 8.3% of babies are underweight.
Bangladesh: 23%, Philippines: 21.1%, and Liberia: 19.9% are also high.
Japan is a surprise for a wealthy nation at 11.3%.
At the other end, Sweden is just 4.1%.
How common are underweight births where you live?
